findings.premise: The daemon registers exactly the four review IPCs S007 consumes — workflow.pending, workflow.artifactContent, workflow.resolveComment, workflow.approve — and there is NO workflow.reject handler.
findings.evidence: src/daemon/index.ts registers workflow.approve (:610), workflow.pending (:634), workflow.artifactContent (:646), workflow.resolveComment (:660) and workflow.run.start/poll/abort/run — there is NO workflow.reject handler (a direct grep of index.ts over the workflow.* keys returns exactly these). The 'no reject IPC -> reject = resolveComment + stay-pending' premise is sound.

findings.premise: workflow.pending is registered in src/daemon/index.ts and delegates to handleWorkflowPending.
findings.evidence: src/daemon/index.ts:634 registers 'workflow.pending' and delegates to handleWorkflowPending (import from ../workflow/pending.js), confirmed by direct read this session.

findings.premise: The daemon PendingArtifact carries artifactId, kind, title, mdPath, openQuestionCount, state — the fields S007 maps to DocsArtifactSummary and uses for open-doc/approve (mdPath).
findings.evidence: src/workflow/pending.ts declares interface PendingArtifact with artifactId/kind/title/mdPath/openQuestionCount/state (read this session); the JetBrains DaemonGateway.kt mirror (openQuestionCount at :37) corroborates the same shape. The PendingArtifact -> DocsArtifactSummary mapping + mdPath retention are sound.

findings.premise: WorkflowApproveResult has approved[], skipped[], and codeReview[] (so a review-blocked artifact is surfaced via skipped[], not an error).
findings.evidence: src/workflow/gates.ts:584 interface WorkflowApproveResult has readonly approved[], readonly skipped[], readonly codeReview[] (read this session). A review-blocked artifact surfaces via skipped[] (non-lossy), not an error — exactly as the LLD relies on.

findings.premise: The plugin's shared IPC client exposes rpc<T>(method, params) (src/shared/ipc-client.ts), the seam createDaemonConfigGateway consumes and S007's DocsReviewClient reuses.
findings.evidence: vscode-plugin/src/config/gateway.ts imports IpcClient from ../../../src/shared/ipc-client.js and createDaemonConfigGateway(client) calls client.rpc<T>('config.catalog'|'config.write') (read this session). The DocsReviewClient reusing client.rpc<T> over the same seam is sound.

api.name: createDocsReviewClient

parameters.name: client
parameters.purpose: The shared daemon IPC client (src/shared/ipc-client.ts), client.rpc<T>(method, params). Same seam createDaemonConfigGateway consumes.

returns.meaning: A vscode-free client over the EXISTING daemon IPCs: pending()->workflow.pending, content(mdPath)->workflow.artifactContent, approve(mdPath)->workflow.approve, comment(artifactId,note)->workflow.resolveComment. Each normalizes the daemon { error } arm into a thrown Error. Mirrors createDaemonConfigGateway.

errors.condition: daemon { error } or socket reject — surfaced to the host as an inline notice.

preconditions: The daemon is reachable over the shared client (the host catches rejections).
postconditions: No cloud REST (k2); acts only on daemon-tracked artifacts (k5); persists nothing.

api.name: DocsReviewClient.pending

returns.meaning: Maps each PendingArtifact {artifactId,kind,title,mdPath,openQuestionCount,state} to DocsArtifactSummary {id:artifactId,kind,title,status:state}; retains id->mdPath. { error } -> throw; { artifacts:[] } -> [].

preconditions: Called on open + after each decision (re-fetch, k5).

api.name: DocsReviewClient.content

parameters.name: mdPath
parameters.purpose: The artifact's rendered .md path from its PendingArtifact.

returns.meaning: { markdown, openQuestions, blocked } from workflow.artifactContent { mdPath }. { error } -> throw.

preconditions: mdPath came from a pending() result (k5).

api.name: DocsReviewClient.approve

parameters.name: mdPath
parameters.purpose: The artifact path to approve, passed as workflow.approve { artifactPath }.

returns.meaning: workflow.approve { artifactPath: mdPath } -> { approved[], skipped[], codeReview[] }. A review-blocked artifact returns in skipped[] with a reason (block gate daemon-side, k5). No overrideReview from the pane.

errors.condition: socket reject; a blocked artifact is NOT an error (non-lossy skipped[]).

postconditions: On success it leaves the pending set; host re-fetches pending().

parameters.name: artifactId
parameters.purpose: The artifact whose review comment is recorded.

parameters.name: note
parameters.purpose: The reviewer's note (recorded via the existing recordResolution machinery).

returns.meaning: workflow.resolveComment { artifactId, ... } — records the note; the artifact stays pending (the reject/request-changes path; no daemon reject IPC). Mirrors JetBrains annotate.

api.name: createDocsReviewHost

parameters.name: deps
parameters.purpose: Injected seams { createPanel:(opts)=>ChatPanelChannel; client: DocsReviewClient; logger?; genNonce? }. Reuses the S003 ChatPanelChannel seam so the host is vscode-free + FakePanel-testable.

returns.meaning: A vscode-free docs-review webview host (mirrors createChatPanelHost): open() renders the sc1 docs-review shell (one nonce'd CSP script) + posts docs-list from pending(); handles open-doc (->content->docs-content) + docs-decision (accept->approve; !accept->comment), re-fetching pending() after a decision. Holds id->mdPath in memory; persists nothing (k3).

errors.condition: A client throw is caught + posted as an inline notice; never throws outward.

preconditions: extension.ts injects the real createWebviewPanel seam + the DocsReviewClient, behind insrc.chat.enabled.
postconditions: Acts only on daemon-tracked pending artifacts (k5); one nonce'd script under strict CSP, textContent/className only.

api.name: handleMessage
api.signature: handleMessage(message: unknown): void  // docs host: open-doc | docs-decision

parameters.name: message
parameters.purpose: The sc3 WebviewToHost envelope the docs-review webview posts. The chat-panel.ts reserved docs-decision default-case stays a no-op (docs-review is a SEPARATE host).

returns.meaning: open-doc {artifactId} -> resolve mdPath -> content -> post docs-content. docs-decision {artifactId, accept} -> accept: approve(mdPath) + re-post docs-list (+ surface skipped[] block reason); !accept: record a comment + keep pending. Malformed/unknown -> dropped.

preconditions: Called from the docs host's single onMessage handler.
postconditions: Decisions reach the daemon approval flow (ac2); the list re-reflects real state (k5).

dataModelChanges.details: createDocsReviewClient(client) + DocsReviewClient (pending/content/approve/comment) + DocsContent { markdown; openQuestions; blocked }. Maps PendingArtifact -> DocsArtifactSummary + normalizes { error }. No new daemon capability.

errorCases.scenario: workflow.pending returns { error } (repo unresolved / unreadable store).
errorCases.detection: DocsReviewClient.pending sees the { error } arm and throws; the host catch handles it.
errorCases.response: Inline notice with the error text; keep the pane open. Never a silent empty list (all-approved is a distinct empty-success).
errorCases.userImpact: The user sees why + can retry; no crash.

errorCases.detection: client.rpc rejects (createConnection fails); the rejection reaches the host catch.
errorCases.response: 'daemon unreachable' notice; refresh re-attempts. No throw outward.
errorCases.userImpact: Clear offline state, not a blank/hung pane.

errorCases.scenario: workflow.approve returns the artifact in skipped[] with a review block reason.
errorCases.detection: The host inspects WorkflowApproveResult.skipped[] (+ codeReview[]) after approve() — not in approved[].
errorCases.response: Surface the skipped reason inline + leave the artifact listed; no overrideReview from the pane (k5).
errorCases.userImpact: The user learns the block gate withheld approval + why.

errorCases.scenario: workflow.artifactContent returns { error } for a body.
errorCases.detection: DocsReviewClient.content sees the { error } arm and throws; the host catches it around open-doc.
errorCases.response: Post a docs-content notice 'content unavailable' for that id; keep the list intact.
errorCases.userImpact: One body fails with a reason; the rest works.

edgeCases.expected: Empty-state 'no pending documents' line (a success, not an { error }).

edgeCases.input: open-doc for an artifactId not in the held map (stale).
edgeCases.expected: Ignored (or re-fetch) — no content call with an unknown id; no throw.

edgeCases.input: A PendingArtifact with an empty mdPath.
edgeCases.expected: The row lists, but open-doc yields 'content unavailable' rather than content('') — guarded before the rpc.

edgeCases.input: accept for an artifact already approved out-of-band.
edgeCases.expected: approve() is idempotent daemon-side (non-lossy); the host re-fetches and the row drops — no error.
The pane prompts; an empty note is a no-op (nothing recorded, stays pending).

edgeCases.input: Panel disposed while a call is in flight.
edgeCases.expected: The resolved post is a no-op (fire-and-forget); no throw, no leak.

invariantsToPreserve.text: The docs-review webview keeps EXACTLY ONE nonce'd inline script under strict CSP; list/body/controls via textContent + className only (never innerHTML), no remote origin, no asWebviewUri — the S003 shell contract.

The pane acts ONLY on daemon-tracked pending-approval artifacts (workflow.pending/artifactContent/approve/resolveComment) — never ad-hoc chat files (k5); the list is a projection of the single source of truth (.insrc/artifacts).
No direct cloud REST (k2): every daemon call goes through the shared IpcClient.rpc seam (the createDaemonConfigGateway idiom); no network path of its own.
Approval goes through the daemon flow (workflow.approve); the code-review block gate is enforced daemon-side + surfaced via skipped[], never bypassed by the pane (ac2/k5).
DocsReviewClient + createDocsReviewHost stay vscode-free (all vscode via the injected createPanel seam + injected client), unit-testable with a FakePanel + a fake IpcClient.

S007 adds NO new daemon capability and NO new Epic shared contract: it consumes sc1 + sc3 + the existing four workflow.* IPCs; the only sc3 touch is the additive optional docs-content/open-doc messages (non-breaking).

migration.stateBefore: Per s1: the daemon already exposes workflow.pending/artifactContent/resolveComment/approve (built for the JetBrains panel) but the VS Code plugin has NO client or surface: no DocsReviewClient, no docs-review webview, no command. sc3 declares docs-list + docs-decision + DocsArtifactSummary but they are unused; chat-panel.ts drops docs-decision in its reserved default case. sc3 has no body channel or read intent. Behind flag insrc.chat.enabled.
migration.stateAfter: A new vscode-free DocsReviewClient over the shared IpcClient wraps the four IPCs (normalizing { error }); a new vscode-free createDocsReviewHost renders the sc1 docs-review webview (list + body + accept/reject/comment), re-fetching after each decision. sc3 gains two additive optional messages (open-doc, docs-content). package.json contributes insrc.chat.docsReview; extension.ts registers it inside the insrc.chat.enabled gate. No daemon change; no new Epic contract; nothing persisted (k3).

migrationSteps.action: Add the two additive optional sc3 messages to protocol.ts: HostToWebview docs-content { artifactId, markdown, openQuestions, blocked } + WebviewToHost open-doc { artifactId } (+ their type-name arrays).
Add docs-review-client.ts (createDocsReviewClient + types) over the shared IpcClient; nothing wired yet.
Add docs-review-panel.ts (createDocsReviewHost) over the injected ChatPanelChannel seam + DocsReviewClient; renders the sc1 docs-review shell; not wired yet.
Add the insrc.chat.docsReview command to package.json contributes.commands.
Wire extension.ts inside the insrc.chat.enabled gate: construct the client + host with the real createWebviewPanel seam + register the command.
Add docs-review-client.test.ts + docs-review-panel.test.ts + extension-chat-wiring.test.ts assertions; run the full sweep + tsc --noEmit.

migration.backwardCompat: No public/shared-contract API removed or reshaped. sc3 gains only ADDITIVE optional union members (open-doc, docs-content) — non-breaking (existing switches ignore unknown types; the chat panel is unaffected). docs-list/docs-decision unchanged. No daemon change (the four IPCs already exist). No new persisted state (k3). The docs-review surface is a NEW command gated behind insrc.chat.enabled; prior stories untouched.
